To enable faster superpod evaluation for further interconnect exploration, we derive a surrogate model that combines OTP parameters with analytical models of PEX mechanisms.

extra_quotes: To make protocol effects explicit, ProtoBridge introduces two abstraction layers over ns-3 to evaluate different scale-up protocols using a common simulation substrate: (1) an operation-to-packet (OTP) layer that captures protocol-specific packet exchanges and dependencies, and (2) a packet-execution (PEX) layer that applies shared packet-level mechanisms to the ns-3 event system.
The high simulation time also hinders efficient end-to-end superpod evaluation and design exploration.
Large errors occur at medium data sizes, which are caused by the NCCL software overhead not modeled at the protocol layer.
